home.title: Fata gahunda n'abaganga n'ibitaro byizewe
home.subtitle: Shaka umusizi ukwiye,ugereranye amahitamo maze ufate gahunda mu masegonda make, aho uri hose mu Rwanda.
home.featuresLead: Waba umuganga, umuhanda, umurima cyangwa umukinnyi, Ubuzima Bwiza itanga inama z'ubuvuzi aho uri hose.
home.feature1Body: Abaganga bagenzuwe mbere yo kwinjira ku rubuga.
home.feature2Body: Ikiganiro, video, n'ubufasha bwihutirwa igihe cyose.
home.feature3Body: Amateka, imiti, n'ubuvuzi mu kibanza kimwe.
home.feature4Body: Menya ibikurikira mbere yo kubona umuganga.
home.aiCtaBody: Sobanura ibimenyetso mu Kinyarwanda, Icyongereza cyangwa Igifaransa ubone inama n'abaganga ushobora gufata.
home.specialistsLead: Itsinda ryacu ry'abaganga b'inzobere ritanga serivisi nziza ku muryango wawe wose.
home.chronicBody: Huza n'umuganga wihariye wo gukomeza kwita indwara nka diyabete, impawu z'umutima, asma n'indi.
home.storiesLead: Inkuru z'ukuri z'abantu bakoresha Ubuzima Bwiza.
home.story1Quote: Nabonye umuganga byihuse kandi byoroshye. Ubufasha kuri chat no gufata gahunda byatumye numva ntekanye.
home.story2Quote: Teleconsultation yadukijije amasaha yo kugenda ubwo umwana wanjye yagiraga umuriro.
home.story3Quote: Nafashe gahunda n'umusizi utavuye mu karere kanjye. Gukomeza kwita impawu z'umutima byoroshye.
home.ctaTitle: Injira mu rubuga rw'ubuvuzi rwizewe mu Rwanda
home.ctaBody: Fungura konti yubuntu uhabwe telemedicine, ukurikirane amateka yawe, ufate gahunda n'abaganga b'inzobere.

about.title: Ubuvuzi buhuza imirimo yose
about.body: Waba umuganga, umuhanda, umurima cyangwa umukinnyi, Ubuzima Bwiza itanga inama z'ubuvuzi bwo mu rwego rw'isi aho uri hose mu Rwanda.

contact.title: Fata gahunda / Twandikire
contact.body: Twandikire ku bibazo byose cyangwa ibijyanye n'ubuvuzi. Abaganga bacu bazasubiza ibyo bisaba vuba.

legal.privacyBody: Turinda amakuru y'abantu dukoresha encryption n'uburenganzira bushingiye ku nshingano.
legal.termsBody: Ukoresha Ubuzima Bwiza wemera gukoresha telemedicine n' serivisi z' gahunda mu buryo bwitondewe.
legal.disclaimer: Iyi kopi ni igaragaza gusa. Shyira amategeko yemewe n'inama y'amategeko mbere yo gukoresha mu bucuruzi.

announcement.title: Amakuru ku rubuga
announcement.body: Ubushobozi bwa teleconsult bwagutse ku bumenyi bw'imitima n'abana muri iki cyumweru.

doctors.doc2Bio: Umuti w'abana ufite uburambe bw'imyaka 12 mu Rwanda.
doctors.doc3Bio: Inama mu by'ubwonko n'indwara z'ubwonko zidakira.
doctors.doc6Bio: Ubuzima bw'abagore, kwita inda, n'ubuvuzi bw'imyororokere.

help.title: Uko Ubuzima Bwiza ikora
help.lead: Ibisubizo bigufi ku barwayi, abaganga, n'abagenzura. Mu gihe cy'ihutirwa, hamagara 112 cyangwa SAMU 912.
help.a1: Oya. Atanga ubuyobozi bwa mbere n'inama z'inzobere gusa. Ntashobora gusuzuma, gutanga imiti, cyangwa gusimbura serivisi z'ihutirwa.
help.a2: Shakisha umuganga, hitamo itariki n'ubwoko bw'urugendo, hanyuma wishyure na MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, ikarita, cyangwa amafaranga ku kigo. Amafaranga ni RWF.
help.a3: Icyongereza, Ikinyarwanda, n'Igifaransa. Koresha ihitamo ry'ururimi hejuru. AI ishobora gusubiza mu rurimi wanditse.
help.a4: Umurwayi, umuganga, ibitaro, n'umuyobozi w'urubuga. Koresha konti z'igerageza ku paji yo kwinjira.
help.a5: Ntutegereze ikiganiro kuri interineti. Hamagara 112 cyangwa SAMU 912, cyangwa ujye ku bitaro bikwegereye.
help.q6: Amakuru yanjye arinzwe muri iyi porogaramu?
help.a6: Iki gice cy'ishuri kibika amakuru y'igerageza muri mushakisha kugira ngo ikizamini gikore ku mudasobwa. Sisitemu y'ukuri yakoresha seriveri irinzwe.
